paper_title: ADMX SLIC: Results from a Superconducting LC Circuit Investigating Cold Axions
notes: First results from ADMX SLIC, a superconducting LC-circuit haloscope searching for axion dark matter. New measured exclusion limits on g_agamma over three narrow mass bands: 1.7498-1.7519e-7 eV (4.5 T), 1.7734-1.7738e-7 eV (5.0 T), 1.8007-1.8015e-7 eV (7.0 T). The abstract states exclusions reach couplings below 1e-12 GeV^-1; exact limit curves are only in Fig. 4 (no numerical table), so the emitted coupling value of ~1e-12 GeV^-1 across each band is an approximation from the text. Actual limits vary within each band and by run (higher B-field runs are somewhat stronger). DM density of 0.45 GeV/cm^3 is the standard ADMX halo assumption (from the associated thesis/analysis), not explicitly stated in this letter. RFI-limited analysis; blue curves in Fig. 4 are the actual exclusions. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.6, 6))
